title: Generative Cinematographer: Composing Camera and Object Motion in 3D
abstract: arXiv:2610.02180v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current controllable video generation systems often rely on 2D motion trajectories or sparse drag signals for object motion. These controls are ambiguous because the same 2D trajectory can correspond to different 3D motions, especially when the camera and objects move simultaneously. We present Generative Cinematographer (GenCine), a system that lifts a single image into an editable 3D scene scaffold where artists jointly author camera and foreground motion. Artists specify a camera path and move selected foreground regions using local 3D motion handles. Several handles can move different parts of a subject independently, providing a piecewise-rigid approximation to non-rigid motion without a physics simulator or category-specific prior. To communicate these controls to a pretrained video model, we project them into guidance maps. translated_title: 生成式摄影指导：在三维空间中协同编排相机与物体运动
translated_abstract: 当前的可控视频生成系统通常依赖二维运动轨迹或稀疏的拖拽信号来控制物体运动。这些控制方式存在歧义，因为同一条二维轨迹可能对应不同的三维运动，尤其是在相机与物体同时运动的情况下。我们提出了生成式摄影指导，这是一个将单张图像提升为可编辑三维场景骨架的系统，使艺术家能够在其中联合编排相机运动与前景运动。艺术家可以指定一条相机路径，并通过局部三维运动控制柄来移动选定的前景区域。多个控制柄可以独立移动主体的不同部位，从而以分段刚性的方式近似非刚性运动，且无需物理模拟器或特定类别的先验知识。为了将这些控制信息传递给预训练的视频模型，我们将其投影为引导图。这些引导图记录了受控区域在每一帧中出现的位置，并为每个控制柄分配固定的颜色……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GenCine系统通过将单张图像提升为可编辑的三维场景骨架，让艺术家使用相机路径和多个局部三维运动控制柄联合编排相机与物体的运动（包括无需物理模拟的非刚性运动），并将其投影为引导图来控制预训练视频模型的生成。
en_tdlr: GenCine lifts a single image into an editable 3D scene scaffold where artists jointly author camera paths and local 3D motion handles—enabling piecewise-rigid approximation of non-rigid motion without physics simulators—and projects these controls into guidance maps to steer a pretrained video generation model.
